title: Open Roll 5e: By the Books
description: The 2024 D&D rules, played from the sheet. Every rule in the Player's Handbook, Dungeon Master's Guide, Monster Manual, Heroes of Faerûn, Arcana Unleashed and Ravenloft: The Horrors Within that rides a use or an effect runs itself: a hit rolls and applies its own damage, saves resolve for every target, a reaction that could change the outcome holds the chain and asks the player with the book's text and a timer, concentration, auras, cover, feats, fighting styles, masteries, maneuvers and metamagic are all in, and rests, senses, sizes and lights follow the sheet too. Every automatic step leaves a receipt and a one-click revert; the module offers, never enforces. Zero dependencies, no sockets, no patching: clients coordinate by reading the same chat log. Formerly Battle Flow.
